newsitem.title: USA: Phoenix Resources to buy Kelcas, GHC.
newsitem.headline: Phoenix Resources to buy Kelcas, GHC.

text.p: Phoenix Resources Technologies Inc said it agreed to buy all of the outstanding stock of Kelcas Corp, Kelcas Well Service Ltd and GHC Corp of Owensborough, Ky for about $1.5 million.

When completed in mid-October 1996, this acquisition will add about $1.3 million gross revenue annually to PRTI. The acquisition will be effected by issuance of one million shares of PRTI common stock and assumption of $600,000 of debt.
Assets of these corporations include 265 producing or produceable wells, 47 water flood wells and the equipment necessary to operate the properties as well as enhance current production.
